notes.title: Demo version 0.4.3 updates
notes.content:
[h3]A Few UI/UX Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] When the player submits an incorrect answer, the rows of clues that are violated by the answer will now have a shaking effect in addition to turning red.
[*] When the player submits a correct answer, a button to proceed to the next level will be shown.
[*] Fullscreen mode has been reintroduced, and an exit game button has been added to the settings menu.
[/list]

tags.feature: When the player submits a correct answer, a button to proceed to the next level will be shown.
Fullscreen mode has been reintroduced, and an exit game button has been added to the settings menu.

notes.title: Demo version 0.4.2 updates
notes.content:
[h2]UI/UX Changes in the Game Screen[/h2]

[list]
[*] The in-game keyboard will now be displayed on the Game screen.
[*] You now can enter coloring mode while drawing.
[*] Fullscreen mode has been disabled.
[/list]

tags.feature: The in-game keyboard will now be displayed on the Game screen.
You now can enter coloring mode while drawing.

notes.title: Demo version 0.4.1 updates
notes.content:
[h3]Few UI/UX changes in Game screen[/h3]

[list]
[*] Descriptions of pegs (such as green triangles, etc.) will now be displayed on the game screen.
[*] Drawings will be preserved when you toggle drawing mode.
[*] The boxes containing the digits will no longer be clickable unless you are in coloring mode.
[/list]
